content: The contents of one bottle (118 mL) are to be administered rectally as a single dose. This product may also be used following barium studies. The patient should lie on their left side with the right knee bent. The enema tip should be gently inserted into the rectum using slight side-to-side movements, directing the tip toward the navel. To facilitate insertion, the patient should bear down as if having a bowel movement to relax the anal muscles. The enema tip should not be forced into the rectum. The bottle should be squeezed to deliver the entire contents. After administration, the enema tip should be removed from the rectum. The enema should be retained as per the doctor’s instructions. If the stool remains hard or inadequately lubricated, a cleansing enema may be required. For children under 1 year of age, the safety and efficacy of this product have not been established. For children aged 2 to 12 years, administer half a bottle (59 mL) rectally as a single dose. For individuals over 12 years of age, the dosage is the same as for adults: the contents of one bottle (118 mL) rectally as a single dose. The patient should lie on their left side with the right knee bent. The enema tip should be gently inserted into the rectum using slight side-to-side movements, directing the tip toward the navel. To ease insertion, the patient should bear down as if having a bowel movement to relax the anal muscles. The enema tip should not be forced into the rectum. Squeeze the bottle to deliver the appropriate dose. Remove the enema tip from the rectum after administration. Retain the enema as directed by the doctor. If the stool remains hard or inadequately lubricated, a cleansing enema may be necessary. Potential side effects include anal seepage, pruritus ani (itching around the anus), perianal discomfort, and hypersensitivity reactions. This product should not be used in patients with colostomy, ileostomy, appendicitis, ulcerative colitis, or diverticulitis. It is contraindicated in children under 13 years of age, bedridden patients, and those currently taking stool softeners or laxatives. This product is for rectal use only. Excessive use may lead to electrolyte imbalances, steatorrhea (fatty stools), osteomalacia (softening of the bones), diarrhea, and cathartic colon (colon damage due to chronic laxative use). Consult a healthcare professional if laxatives have been used for more than three days, if abdominal pain, nausea, or vomiting occur, or if there are sudden changes in bowel habits that persist for more than two weeks. This product should only be used at bedtime and should not be administered at any other time or to infants unless directed by a physician. Discontinue use and consult a healthcare professional if bleeding occurs after use or if a bowel movement does not occur within 30 minutes of enema administration. Keep this product out of the reach of children. If swallowed, seek medical assistance or contact a Poison Control Center immediately at 800-222-1222. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk, and the product is generally considered acceptable for use during pregnancy. Always consult a healthcare professional before use.
